name: cursor-essential
description: Preserved descriptions and input schemas for 13 discovered Cursor tools, packaged as portable Agent Skills. Standalone execution via sibling agent-essential-runtime (MCP/CLI).

interface.longDescription: Thirteen portable Agent Skills preserve discovered Cursor tool descriptions and input schemas. Standalone execution uses agent-essential-runtime (npm/MCP); see docs/runtime.md. In Cursor, native cursor tools remain preferred when available.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the relevant cursor-essential Skill; execute via agent-essential-runtime MCP/CLI or native cursor tools when in Cursor.
